claims.statement: Tom Allen and Jem Mace were to fight near New Orleans on 10 May 1870.
claims.excerpt: the great mill between Tom Allen and Jem Mace will take place near New Orleane

claims.statement: Opinion in St. Louis favoured Mace to win, while Allen was the favourite at New Orleans.
claims.excerpt: The general opinion here is that Mace will win, but st New Orleans Allen is the favorite

fights.excerpt: the great mill between Tom Allen and Jem Mace will take place near New Orleane
fights.notes: Written before the fight; the result is in article 399.
